PNI’s flagship NaviGuider™ module combining its RM3100 magnetometer with an accelerometer, gyroscope, and low-power Edge-AI coprocessor running continuous hard/soft-iron auto-calibration and a 15-state Kalman filter was named a finalist for the DIRA Technology Award 2026 at Robotbrag in Odense, Denmark. As PNI accelerates European commercial adoption across Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), marine buoys, and defense unmanned aerial systems (UAS), their internal engineering teams face bandwidth demands to build standardized customer-facing SDKs, ROS2/Linux driver interfaces, and continuous firmware enhancement suites. Job Description
Special Instructions to Applicants: All interested applicants must attach a cover letter and a resume in the Supporting Documents section of the application in a PDF format. Please note that the applicant tracking system does not convert attachments in Word format successfully.
Position Summary
The Susanne M. Glasscock School of Continuing Studies (GSCS) connects Rice University to Houston and the world, offering exemplary educational opportunities for career changers, game-changers, lifelong learners, and everyone in between. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of digital innovation and delivering exceptional solutions to our programs. With a collaborative and supportive work environment, we offer opportunities for growth, skill development, and meaningful contributions. As a Web Developer, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our digital projects and driving our schools success.
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cutting-edge web applications that meet the need of our programs and exceed their expectations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly solutions that drive business growth and success. This position may perform special projects upon request and, on occasion, provide guidance to others at the school.
We celebrate diversity of all kinds, and we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. We are part of a private university, but our team comes from various backgrounds and includes people who attended universities and community colleges, as well as people who did not graduate from college.
The ideal candidate will be a talented and experienced web developer who is highly motivated, skilled, and can create and maintain websites. The individual will help design, build, and implement new, highly-quality, high-performance web-based applications and tools that leverage available technology infrastructure.
This position offers a flexible work schedule and can be fully remote. This position requires U.S. work authorization.
The minimum annual hiring range is $73,326, contingent upon qualifications and experience.
Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree
Two (2) years of related professional experience in web development

Skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Demonstrated ability to develop web content management systems
Demonstrated ability to develop complex websites and web applications using open source tools, languages, libraries, and current standards-compliant code
Knowledge of web content development and cloud services
Expert level knowledge of front-end development languages and ability to hand code HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Solid understanding of web standards and usability methods
Expert knowledge of content management systems, such as Drupal, including the ability to perform standard installation and configuration
Demonstrated ability to write, compile, test, debug, and deploy software
Knowledge of web analytics tools and related analyses
Ability to design and manage relational databases
Ability to design and implement web services
Ability to interact positively with and build consensus among a diverse group of colleagues, clients, and senior leadership

Four (4) years of demonstrated experience in both front and back-end web development 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Proficiency with GitHub, Snowflake, and Google Apps

Essential Functions

Design, develop, and maintain Glasscock School websites
Implements and maintains content management systems 
Evaluates third-party modules for functionality, accessibility, security, and maintainability 
Performs selected website administration duties for existing clients 
Ensures web server and site technical performance 
Creates web pages and tools for Rice websites using core technologies 
Creates and / or modifies clean, well-structured, search engine optimization-friendly documented code 
Provides technical expertise in front- and back-end web development 
Supports web infrastructure by providing end-user support, applications maintenance, product evaluation, back-end development, and internal management tools 
Interprets website design and layout visually in a creative, contemporary style and fully integrated manner 
Ensures high quality and consistent look and feel across multiple devices and browsers 
Optimizes the display of original online content, and collaborates with content manager to produce animated gifs, static buttons, and email and landing pages 
Works with site architects to develop and document functional specifications based on requirements gathered from stakeholders 
Supports the implementation of life cycle 
Helps develop and deploy upgrade / migration plans for existing content management system as needed 
Performs all other duties as assigned.
Ability to work effectively with multiple internal and external customers. 
Collaborates with client/department manager to standardize and systemize routine reports, dashboards, and metrics.
May test prototype software and participate in the approval and release process for new software.

data.notes:
Headcount: 50–120 employees globally across Australia, North America, Europe, and South Africa

Estimated Revenue: $15M – $35M USD ARR

HQ Location: Perth, Western Australia (Global HQ) / Atlanta, Georgia, USA (North American Ops) / Johannesburg, South Africa

Quick Fit Evaluation: Outstanding connected hardware, industrial asset tracking, and battery-powered IoT device target for Stellix Soft. Digital Matter is a global leader in low-power GPS and IoT asset tracking hardware, deploying over 2.5 million devices across 120+ countries. They design and manufacture ruggedized, battery-powered tracking hardware (Oyster3, Yabby3, Remora3, Barra, Barra Edge, Hawk IoT Gateway) leveraging Cellular IoT (LTE-M/NB-IoT), Satellite (Iridium/Swarm/Direct-to-Cell), BLE 5.2, Wi-Fi Locationing, and LoRaWAN connectivity. Enterprise telematics providers and system integrators deploying Digital Matter hardware frequently demand custom software work such as custom MCU firmware drivers for external sensors, specialized low-overhead telemetry serialization protocols, and custom cloud API integration middleware connecting Digital Matter's OEM Server platform into proprietary enterprise platforms (SAP, IBM Maximo, AWS IoT). Stellix Soft can step in as an external engineering partner to offload custom firmware drivers, protocol translation, and cloud middleware backlogs.

intentEvidence.label: Barra Edge Series Launch, Hybrid Satellite Telematics Expansion & OEM Server API Scaling
intentEvidence.explanation: Digital Matter manufactures some of the most widely deployed low-power tracking hardware in the global IoT ecosystem. As enterprise fleets, logistics providers, and heavy industrial clients deploy Digital Matter devices across global supply chains, clients frequently require custom software engineering. This includes writing custom C/C++ sensor drivers for the Hawk IoT gateway, tuning low-power firmware logic for extended battery life on the Oyster3, or engineering cloud API connectors that stream raw telemetry from Digital Matter's OEM Server directly into enterprise ERP or SCADA systems. Stellix Soft can assist Digital Matter by offloading custom device firmware, protocol decoders, and cloud API middleware development.

Quick Fit Evaluation: Prime high-value target for Stellix Soft. SKYWAVE (an ORBCOMM company) is a pioneer in global satellite-cellular IoT hardware, connectivity management, and application enablement platforms (OGx). SKYWAVE partnered with Iridium Communications to advance global industrial IoT for heavy equipment OEMs. The strategic partnership integrates SKYWAVE’s intelligent multi-network orchestration and OGx IoT platform with Iridium’s global LEO satellite network and Short Burst Data (SBD®) services. This enables heavy equipment OEMs (construction, mining, agriculture) to run remote diagnostics, predictive maintenance, and telematics seamlessly across satellite, cellular, and Wi-Fi networks worldwide. As SKYWAVE scales this multi-network LEO/cellular architecture across major OEM fleets, its internal engineering group faces heavy software demands to build low-latency failover firmware, unified API gateways, and automated protocol validation test suites. Stellix Soft can step in as a technical software partner to co-develop dual-mode C/C++ edge firmware, cloud ingestion connectors, and automated test harnesses.

data.painPoints:
Radiant is transitioning from prototype engineering toward manufacturing, deployment and eventually fleet operations. Its own product architecture anticipates hundreds of deployed Kaleidos units sending operating data back to a centralized 24/7 fleet-monitoring system. At the same time, it must build manufacturing infrastructure capable of producing standardized reactors at scale.

That creates potential software workload around manufacturing systems, operational dashboards, data infrastructure, internal tooling, deployment workflows, integrations and automated testing. Safety-critical reactor controls should be excluded from the Stellix pitch.

Radiant says Kaleidos is scheduled for a fueled test at Idaho National Laboratory's DOME facility in 2026. Separately, the company is preparing the R-50 factory in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, with plans to scale toward production of 50 reactors annually.  Radiant also announced on February 17, 2026 that Lockheed Martin Ventures had joined its already oversubscribed financing round as a strategic investor.

The December 2025 financing was explicitly raised to support this commercialization effort.

personalizationNote.relevantService: The strongest fit is Enterprise Application Development and Systems Integration, supported by Data Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps and QA Automation.

Radiant also expects deployed reactors to continuously stream health information to a centralized 24/7 fleet-monitoring operation.

transportation/deployment systems and centralized fleet monitoring. The company plans for hundreds of deployed units to stream reactor-health information back to its monitoring operation.

Full Stack Developer React and Node.js
Madison, WI Onsite


We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer React and Node.js with 4 years of hands-on full-stack development experience to join our innovative team. This role offers the opportunity to build high-performance, scalable web applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional user experiences and backend solutions.
Responsibilities
As a key member of our engineering team, you will design and implement responsive, high-performance frontend components using React, React Hooks, and TypeScript, creating reusable and modular UI libraries while integrating with RESTful APIs and GraphQL services. On the backend, you will develop and maintain Node.js services using frameworks like Express.js or NestJS, work with SQL and NoSQL databases, and implement microservices and event-driven architectures. You will participate in system architecture discussions, ensure application performance, security, and scalability, write clean and well-tested code, conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and collaborate with DevOps for deployment and monitoring. You will also work closely with product owners and designers to transform business requirements into robust technical solutions.
Required Skills

4 years of full-stack development experience with strong expertise in React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Node.js with frameworks like Express.js or NestJS.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, database design for SQL and NoSQL databases, API security, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Proven ability in performance optimization, debugging, problem-solving, and effective communication. Certifications in React, Node.js, or cloud technologies are highly desirable.

Desired Skills

Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API, writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Mocha, or Cypress, containerization with Docker, and orchestration with Kubernetes.
Knowledge of message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or SQS is a plus.

It serves 2,800+ NetSuite customers and hundreds of Oracle Cloud customers, with more than 3,000 customers worldwide across 40+ countries.

Key characteristics:

Provides ERP-native WMS and inventory solutions for NetSuite and Oracle Cloud, plus integrated solutions for Microsoft Dynamics AX/D365 and JD Edwards.

Offers 100+ inventory and warehouse tools (receiving, putaway, picking, cycle counting, shipping, labeling), barcoding/RFID, and mobile data collection via handheld devices.

Emphasizes real-time traceability and visibility across the supply chain, helping customers achieve 99.9% inventory accuracy and up to 40% productivity improvement.

Supports regulated environments with SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance, especially in healthcare and life sciences.

Strongest opportunity for Stellix Soft is to position as a complementary engineering partner that extends RF-SMART’s delivery capacity in enterprise/WMS development, ERP integrations, data & analytics, and QA, aligned with their ERP-native and high-accuracy brand promise.

This position is 100% remote, but you must reside in the U.S.
To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews and assessments independently and without the use of artificial intelligence tools (including AI-generated responses, prompts, or real-time assistance). Use of AI throughout the application and recruiting process may result in removal from consideration. Our goal is to get to know your authentic experiences, communication style, and problem-solving approach.
U-Haul is searching for a talented Senior Software Developer to join our team. Come join a stable and ever-expanding IT organization to be part of the quest to elevate us to the next level.  
About The Job
The position is with a software development team that develops and maintains a suite of tier one, mission critical enterprise applications and services used by numerous U-Haul business teams and thousands of U-Haul field locations. Every member of the team makes important contributions which have a direct and significant impact on U-Haul’s business operations.
About You
We are looking for a full-stack software developer who is highly skilled in the ability to apply critical thinking and structured programming fundamentals to real world problems. U-Haul uses the Microsoft development stack (e.g., C#, MVC, SQL, Entity Framework, HTML 5, CSS, Blazor, Web API, jQuery, ASP.NET, and T-SQL), along with non-Microsoft supporting technologies (like Apache Kafka, SPAs, Reddis, etc.) to solve its business problems. We do this through technologies such as web apps and web APIs, and various types of backend persistence, including SQL.
The primary roles and responsibilities of this position include the following:

Writes code that is easily maintainable, highly reliable and demonstrates knowledge of common programming best practices.
Becomes the owner, subject matter expert (SME), and technical lead for individual applications, architecture initiatives, high risk/complexity features. 
Starting with higher level business and technical requirements, independently estimates and breaks down the work. 
Interfaces directly with business stakeholders (business units) or members of other development teams for work item scoping and clarification, communication of status, etc. 
Advanced troubleshooting and problem solving, spanning software, systems and databases. Use a wide array of tools and techniques to identify the root cause and implement robust technical solutions. 
Serve as a technical lead: mentor, train and support other software developers, perform design & code reviews. 
Excellent technical judgement and decision making. Effectively prioritizes and works through problems which are ambiguous, have incomplete specifications and are complex in nature. 
Completes assigned tasks and project work with minimal oversight or direct supervision. 
Respond quickly and effectively to production issues and taking responsibility for seeing those issues through resolution. 

Why Should You Apply?  

Competitive compensation  
Latest technologies 
Team that emphasizes collaboration  
Positive team culture founded by team self-organization principles

Experience/Education/Training

6+ years of professional software development experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field 
Must be a U.S. citizen or have proof of U.S. employment authorization for this position.
Salary range: $90,000-$120,000 annually, depending on experience

data.notes:
BD Industrial (B&D Industrial) is an industrial and manufacturing solutions company founded in 1947 and headquartered in Macon, GA, with multiple locations in Georgia.

It operates three divisions MRO+Automation Solutions, Gearing+Reliability Solutions, and IIoT covering inventory, maintenance, reliability services, custom engineering, and industrial software.

Their offerings include:

Shop services (rebuilds, repairs, machining, rotating equipment expertise, gearbox rebuild, surplus parts).

Field services (on-site precision maintenance, emergency services, 24/7/365 support).

Machining and fabrication, engineering services focused on root-cause reliability and ROI, and specialized material handling solutions.

Electrical and automation products and solutions (PLC-based control, motor controls, industrial panels, communication components).

Key proprietary solutions:

VibePro: Predictive maintenance platform integrating vibration, balancing, shaft alignment, thermography, ultrasound, with route-based and wireless data collection.

OptiPro: IIoT-driven weights and measures data platform with integrated device manager, cloud-based dashboard, data translation for legacy devices, drill-down graphs, and alerts.

BD positions itself as a partner that helps customers move from reactive fixes to long-term reliability and performance using engineering expertise and data-driven solutions.

The strongest opportunity for Stellix Soft is to support BD Industrial’s software- and data-heavy IIoT initiatives (VibePro, OptiPro, Industry 4.0 integrations) by acting as an external engineering partner across software development, analytics, integrations, and platform scalability.

Problem-solving and adaptability in a fast-changing digital landscape.

Quick Fit Evaluation: Premier post-quantum cryptographic hardware IP and quantum-safe infrastructure target for Stellix Soft. On August 7, 2026, BTQ Technologies announced the successful completion of the first milestone in its multi-year collaboration with Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) to validate BTQ's Quantum Compute-in-Memory (QCIM) architecture. Formic as part of the global QCIM chip roadmap led jointly by BTQ and South Korea's ICTK Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ: 456010), this milestone verified that BTQ's soft IP cryptographic accelerator can accurately and efficiently execute NIST-standardized PQC algorithms specifically FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA), and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA) under demanding conditions. With plans to ship test chips to key strategic partners by year-end for performance and functional validation, BTQ is advancing into module-level integration, verification, and hardware driver SDK enablement across IoT, AI devices, industrial systems, defense, automotive, and Physical AI. Stellix Soft can support BTQ as a specialized software and hardware verification partner to build low-level C/C++ driver abstractions, hardware abstraction layers (HAL), testbench verification environments, and client integration SDKs.
data.nextAction: Target BTQ Technologies' hardware, silicon engineering, and cryptographic architecture leads (specifically teams under Olivier Roussy Newton, CEO & Chairman, alongside product and firmware engineering leads across Taipei, Vancouver, Sydney, and Seoul working on the QCIM soft IP accelerator, FIPS 203/204/205 compliance, and test chip validation) to offer custom ASIC/FPGA digital design verification, SystemVerilog/UVM testbench development, low-level driver/HAL SDK co-development, and cloud/edge cryptographic protocol integration middleware.

Partnering with Stellix Soft allows BTQ to offload hardware driver, test suite, and software SDK engineering, ensuring seamless customer evaluation without slowing core cryptanalytic or chip architecture development.

Quick Fit Evaluation: High-value global IoT semiconductor and software platform target for Stellix Soft. On August 5, 2026, Espressif announced ESP RainMaker Neo, fully open-sourcing their complete device-to-cloud-to-phone IoT platform stack under the Apache License 2.0. Rebuilt on native AWS Serverless architecture (Go/SAM backend, MQTT over TLS, REST APIs, TypeScript/React Native mobile SDK), RainMaker Neo allows OEMs, system integrators, and enterprises to deploy and run their own private IoT cloud directly within their AWS accounts. While the core platform is now open-source, Espressif is monetization-focused on commercial enterprise modules (Admin SSO, Role-Based Access Control, audit logs, managed updates, business analytics) and technical support for large-scale deployments. As thousands of hardware developers and OEMs evaluate and deploy Neo, Espressif's software engineering and professional services teams face heavy workloads to build customer-requested enterprise features, cloud-to-cloud integrations, and custom React Native mobile app extensions. Stellix Soft can step in as an external software engineering team to co-develop enterprise add-on packages, customize cloud backends, and build custom AWS serverless pipelines for Espressif's enterprise OEM clients.

data.painPoints:
Preventing core silicon and hardware application engineers from getting bogged down writing custom, client-specific MCU firmware drivers and OTA update stacks.

Accelerating the time-to-market for enterprise OEMs porting legacy 8-bit/16-bit or earlier TXZ designs to the secure M4V 32-bit architecture.
data.triggerEvent: Public availability of engineering samples and starter kits for the TXZ+™ Family M4V Group in August 2026.
data.notes:
Headcount: 110,000+ employees globally (Toshiba Group); 1,000–2,000 across TAEC / Semiconductor divisions

Estimated Revenue: $23B – $26B USD equivalent global revenue

HQ Location: Tokyo, Japan (Global HQ) / Irvine, California, USA (Toshiba America Electronic Components)

Quick Fit Evaluation: Tier-1 semiconductor and microelectronics target for Stellix Soft. In August 2026, Toshiba launched engineering sample shipments for the TXZ+™ Family Entry-Class M4V Group. Built on an Arm® Cortex®-M4 core (with FPU up to 80MHz and 2.7V–5.5V support), the M4V Group features a multi-layered security architecture (Chip Protection, Secure Access Memory), 128KB code flash, 64KB data flash, and an integrated Serial Memory Interface (SMIF) designed specifically for direct high-speed execution from external serial flash during OTA firmware updates. As industrial equipment and IoT appliance OEMs evaluate M4V engineering samples, Toshiba's field applications engineering (FAE) and enablement teams face heavy demand to supply starter kit sample code, board support packages (BSPs), motor control drivers (A-PMD2), and secure OTA bootloader integrations. Stellix Soft can step in as an external software engineering partner to offload CMSIS driver development, OTA update bridges, and OEM host firmware backlogs.
data.nextAction: Target Toshiba America Electronic Components (TAEC) and Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage microcontroller product leadership to offer specialized Arm Cortex-M4 C/C++ firmware engineering support, CMSIS-compliant BSP/driver extensions, Serial Memory Interface (SMIF) external flash middleware, and custom Over-The-Air (OTA) secure bootloader development for OEM customers adopting the new TXZ+™ M4V series.

intentEvidence.explanation: Toshiba's August 2026 launch of the TXZ+ M4V Group targets industrial IoT and consumer systems requiring robust on-chip security and OTA update capabilities. The inclusion of the Serial Memory Interface (SMIF) enables direct execution from external serial flash, freeing internal memory but adding software development overhead around flash memory mapping, access control (SAM), and secure bootloader execution. As OEM clients evaluate M4V samples for new 5V industrial designs, Toshiba's internal software teams will face bottlenecks in creating specialized application code, driver packages, and cloud-to-chip OTA middleware. Stellix Soft can support Toshiba's ecosystem by developing custom C/C++ firmware modules, secure bootloaders, and CMSIS middleware drivers.

data.notes:
Source: .net Linkedin (linkedin · hiring)
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/full-stack-engineer-at-intelligems-4422383637

There are millions of e-commerce businesses around the world, and the industry is growing each year, yet achieving profitability has never been harder. Costs are rising, it’s trickier to acquire customers, and it's critical to run with lean teams. As a result, the vast majority of brands guess about things like how to price their products, what discounts to offer, whether to charge for shipping, and what content they should show on the site, leaving 6–10% of potential profit on the table.
Intelligems is a profit growth platform that helps these entrepreneurs succeed by uncovering that profit. Our platform provides e-commerce merchants with a wide range of A/B testing and personalization tools to help them understand their data, run experiments, and price dynamically. We’re taking technology that has previously been available only to the Amazons and Ubers of the world, and making it available to e-commerce stores of any size.
We have excellent traction: we’re working with over 2,000 brands and have access to more than $10B of transaction and shopping session data. As we enter scaling mode, we are looking for highly talented individuals to join us and help us continue to scale efficiently. We have an extremely high-performing team, with a collaborative culture of low-ego + high-IQ people. Our people are our strongest asset, and we hold a very high bar.
We're backed by Stage 2 Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Matchstick Ventures, Techstars, and the founders of companies like Klaviyo and Postscript, and have raised >$11M to date.
The Role 
Roll up your sleeves and let’s build together! From day one, we’ll ask you to contribute to any and every aspect of our stack. It could be adding new functionality to the core experimentation capabilities of the platform, designing and implementing a new integration, or reworking a complicated user flow.
Our team is lean and mean — less than 10 engineers and only a handful of product and design. This means you’ll work closely with everyone, including those in non-technical roles like our sales, support, and success teams.
Month one will be characterized by “learning by doing” - taking on features that are meaningful in impact with input from other teammates to get deep in the codebase and concepts while also providing value to our customers.
From there you’ll tackle increasingly complex and ambiguous problems. With varying degrees of input from your product and design teammates, you’ll figure out the implementation details from schema and API design to UI polish.
We have thousands of customers, too, so there are often opportunities to work directly or indirectly with them. Understanding the customer perspective and having empathy are important skills that will help make you effective in each of the countless micro design decisions you make each day.
Tech Stack
Knowledge in all of these is not required, but you should be excited to work within and help us improve the stack.

TypeScript monorepo
Frontend - React web app hosted on AWS S3/Cloudfront; Redux, Material UI, ReactQuery
Backend - Serverless NodeJS hosted on AWS Lambda, managed by SST. MySQL database. Also includes SQS queues, Dynamo tables, dockerized lambdas, etc….
“Plugin” - Compiled client-side javascript written in Typescript
Analytics - AWS Eventbus, Kinesis, Flink, Kafka, and Clickhouse.

You’re a Great Fit If

You have experience owning product and feature development from ideation to delivery 
You’re able to hold a lot of context in your head — there are a lot of moving pieces here to keep in mind
Exploration, learning, and experimentation are core to your process
You have deep expertise in areas that will level us up
At the same time have curiosity to learn try a different approach
You empathize with our customers, and care deeply about making them successful
You're a team player and can work collaboratively while also being independent
You want to shape the future of e-commerce

Note: please only apply to ONE software engineering role at Intelligems. We are able to move candidates between the Frontend & Full Stack roles as needed.
What’s Offered

Competitive salary and equity packages
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401k + match
Flexible PTO policy
Parental leave
$ to spend quarterly with our growing list of brands
WFH setup stipend
Laptop provided
Team meetups and events

Intelligems is a remote-first company with 4 offices (NYC, Denver, Boston, and Chicago), but please note that some travel may be required. 
All Intelligems interviews are transcribed by an AI notetaker.
